text:
maria: heads up — staging gRPC checks started flapping after a terraform deploy.
chris: which deploy? tf plan/applied?
maria: applied yesterday that bumped svc.port for model-gateway to 8443 but left container still listening on 8080. I think node->pod port mapping got inconsistent.
sam: headless svc + GatewayAPI NLB passthrough is fragile when ports don't line up.
maria: current svc yaml (simplified):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: model-gateway
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  ports:
    - name: tls
      port: 8443
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: model
```
chris: with headless, the Gateway (and NLB) expects endpoints to serve on the same port the LB probes. If the targetPort != port, probes hit the wrong port on pod.
maria: the NLB healthcheck was hitting :8443 but pod exposed 8080 — caused failures.
sam: checklist:
- keep service `port` == `targetPort` for TLS/pass-through use-cases
- use named ports (eg `tls`) for Gateway route matching
- if you switch to LoadBalancer svc type, set `externalTrafficPolicy: Local` to preserve source IP for healthchecks
- prefer non-headless for LB-backed services unless you know the LB will route to pod IPs

chris: quick repro commands:
```
# from outside the k8s nodes
openssl s_client -connect <node-ip>:8443 -servername model.example.internal
# from within cluster: test directly to pod IP
curl -sS --http2-prior-knowledge http://<pod-ip>:8080/healthz
```
maria: infra-bot rolled back the staged svc port change -> 1971234590
deploy-bot: roll: svc/model-gateway rollback applied by infra-bot at 1971234590
maria: i'll open a tiny PR to set targetPort: 8443 in the deployment container or revert the tf change. tagging @chris @sam for quick review.
chris: lgtm, please add a short comment in the manifest explaining headless+passthrough caveat and include the openssl test. :+1:
sam: also add a note to terraform module docs so future port bumps include container ports. :shipit:
maria: thanks — PR in 8m.
